name: nov3
note: main dev recording, 12.7 GiB; fixes (St Ives, Cambs UK)

name: tuni2025
note: Tampere Univ. clear-sky 2025, 50 MHz zero-IF, ~150s. The dataset labels it 32-bit float but it is int16 big-endian (2xi16-be). Carries BOTH constellations: 8 Galileo E1B SVs fix at 61.4500, 23.8563, and 16 GPS L1CA SVs (--sig L1CA) fix at 61.4501, 23.8566 (both Tampere, ~few m) -- prime candidate for a combined GPS+Galileo fix.

name: fgi-osnma
note: FGI OSNMA (Finland 2023), L1/E1 i8 26 MHz fi 6.39 MHz; Galileo fixes (Otaniemi); clean 460s + jammertest + OSNMA bits; manual, see docs/datasets.md

name: ion-lime
note: ION LimeSDR L1, 10 MHz IF 420 kHz, 60s; fixes (Netherlands)

name: cttc
note: gnss-sdr CTTC Spain 2013, ~1.1 GiB; GPS fix + EGNOS; also 3 Galileo IOV E1B ephemerides (E11/E12/E20)

name: texbat-clean
note: TEXBAT clean-static (UT Austin), GPS L1 complex baseband int16 25 MHz, ~80s (7.5 GiB), no header (scott.m reads from byte 0); spoof-free reference -> fixes (Austin TX). The spoofed/evil-waveform sets ds1-ds8 live in the same datastore (each ~44 GiB, first 100s spoof-free) for robustness tests; see docs/datasets.md

name: ion-gn3s
note: ION GN3S (SiGe Sampler v3) L1, real 8-bit IF 4.092 MHz, ~120s; collected 2013-05-23 in North America (CU GNSS Lab) -- NOT Munich (upstream/sdrx label is wrong; sub-sat geometry puts G09 overhead Baja, below Munich's horizon). GPS L1 C/A -- GN3S ~2 MHz BW too narrow for E1. Spectrum is inverted (high-side LO, like the IFEN SX3) so --invert-spectrum: deterministically lifts subframes 103->138 and cuts parity errors 11->4 (per-recording, like SJTU is NOT inverted). Still only ~4 weak SVs complete ephemerides -> high-GDOP, intermittent fix in N. America.

name: sjtu
note: ION SJTU Shanghai L1+E1, SX3 4-bit, 60s; tracks 15-29 SVs, no full fix

name: ion-ifen
note: ION IFEN SX3 dual-RF L1, real 2-bit IF 5.5 MHz, 10 MHz BW, ~18 min (Munich 2016, 5.7 GiB); GPS L1 + 4 Galileo E1 (E11/E12/E19/E20). 2-bit reader: 4 samples/byte LSB-first (MSB-first scrambled the carrier, decoded nothing). SX3 spectrum is inverted (high-side LO) -> needs --invert-spectrum or the carrier-aided code loop slips and parity fails despite 50 dB-Hz. GPS fix at Munich (48.078,11.638), TTFF ~25s

name: pocketsdr
note: PocketSDR Tokyo L1, ~30s; tracks GPS + QZSS J194/195/199

name: zenodo-sigmf
note: SigMF ci16, 4 MHz, ~15s; GPS + E1B both track (5 SVs each), too short for a fix

name: ion-bladerf
note: ION BladeRF L1, 10 MHz, ~13s; tracks 13 SVs, too short for a fix

name: jks-1bit
note: jks.com 1-bit real, ~82s; tracks ~7 SVs at a marginal ~30 dB-Hz

name: ion-hackrf
note: ION HackRF L1, 10 MHz; acquires ~11 SVs, nav-decodes and fixes (Netherlands ~52.18,4.49)
